storm-caller.name: Nymphadora Tonks
storm-caller.prompt: A refined editorial gouache and oil painting of a young adult British witch, age twenty-four. Beautifully painted anatomical face with subtle planes, softly blended warm amber highlights and midnight-violet shadows. Fine brush strokes in the hair, richly tactile woven cloak, thick matte pigment and soft painterly edges. Full-bleed painting with a continuous plain dark muted plum backdrop extending to every edge. Three-quarter chest-up portrait, head and hair fully inside the frame, face and shoulders centered, hands below the image. Natural adult human proportions and a distinct heart-shaped face, warm brown eyes, an asymmetrical mischievous gentle smile, short bright bubblegum-pink windswept pixie hair with separate fine painted strands. Purple wool cloak with deep folded fabric, burgundy cashmere scarf, dark charcoal buttoned shirt and a tiny silver ear cuff. Sophisticated storybook portrait of Nymphadora Tonks, lively, clever and rebellious, aged in her twenties. The focus is convincing painted light and volume on her cheekbones, eyes and nose, coherent warm amber light like an old magical alley illustration. Clean unmarked image, pure illustration without any typography or frame.

night-forger.name: Rubeus Hagrid
night-forger.prompt: A refined volumetric editorial gouache and oil painting of Rubeus Hagrid, the enormous gentle half-giant from the Harry Potter books. Chest-up three-quarter portrait of a huge broad-shouldered man whose sheer width and massive warm rounded face immediately identify him as a half-giant. Very broad rounded nose, tiny warm black beetle-like eyes beneath heavy bushy eyebrows, rosy weathered cheeks and a kindly gentle smile mostly hidden in a tremendously long thick tangled dark-brown beard that flows all the way down across his entire chest. His beard is exceptionally voluminous, wider than his face and waist-length, with visibly painted individual curls and strands. Long unruly dark-brown hair in thick tangled waves reaching past both shoulders, with complete hair fitting inside the image. His heavy well-worn brown moleskin coat has thick stitched seams, large brass buttons and huge folded collar, no scarf covering the long beard. Natural mature human facial anatomy, subtly painted amber window light on hair and cheeks, deeply layered indigo shadows, realistic coarse leather and wool texture, fine painterly strokes and convincing physical weight. Warm sophisticated illustrated storybook style matching a beautifully detailed magical alley at dusk. Plain unmarked dark muted plum backdrop extends to every edge, full-bleed painting, hands completely below the lower crop, complete head with comfortable margin, no frame or writing.

root-speaker.name: Alastor Moody
root-speaker.prompt: A refined richly painterly editorial gouache and oil portrait of Alastor Mad-Eye Moody, an old rugged Scottish wizard in his sixties. Chest-up three-quarter view, weathered broad asymmetrical face with healed fine scars, crooked broken nose, grim vigilant expression, grizzled grey hair swept back and a heavy patched olive-brown travelling coat with leather collar and metal buckle. He has exactly two eyes: his right eye is a small normal dark human eye, and his left eye has been replaced by a very large round vivid blue magical glass eye in a tarnished brass socket occupying the normal left eye position on the left half of his face, below his left eyebrow. The blue magical eye replaces an eye, it is not an accessory above the eyes. A dark leather retaining strap wraps around the temple at eye level. The forehead above both eyebrows is plain scarred skin without any eye or jewel. Natural mature adult facial anatomy apart from the one replacement glass eye, strong angular cheekbones, deep wrinkles and a severe mouth. Finely rendered layered old fabric, matte painted volume, detailed soft brushwork, warm amber window light and restrained indigo shadows. Matching a sophisticated illustrated magical alley game. Plain continuous dark muted plum background to every edge, head completely in frame with margin, hands below the frame, clean unmarked painting without typography or border.

veil-walker.name: Lord Voldemort
veil-walker.prompt: A refined dark editorial gouache painting portrait of Lord Voldemort, an inhuman snake-faced bald dark wizard. His unmistakable nose is a flat serpentine area with only TWO THIN VERTICAL SLIT NOSTRILS lying flush with his otherwise flat face, exactly like the flat nose of a snake, with no projecting human nasal tip. His nose bridge and nasal tip are completely absent, so the facial plane between his red eyes and mouth is smooth flat pale skin interrupted by the two narrow slits. Long gaunt ivory-white bald skull, narrow almond-shaped RED eyes, very thin bloodless lips, sunken cheeks and a cold calm unsmiling expression. Unnatural elegant sinister face, clearly the snake-faced wizard Voldemort. Deep green-black robes with heavy sophisticated woven fabric and a sculptural folded collar, slim shoulders, chest-up three-quarter portrait, complete bald head fitting inside the image with margin. Rich painterly volume, fine matte oil-glaze brushwork on ivory skin and textured dark cloth, restrained amber rim light and deep muted indigo shadows. Plain continuous dark muted plum backdrop with clean edges. A sophisticated painted character from a dark wizard trading card game, purely illustrated without writing, border, blood or gore. Hands outside the frame.
